children: Gyrodyne preliminarily estimated net assets in liquidation at $10.75 per share as it pursues a potential sale of Flowerfield acreage to New York State.
Preliminary September 30 net assets in liquidation were $10.75 per share, down $1.55 from June 30, primarily reflecting a lower estimated value for a potential State sale.
Gyrodyne is negotiating a sale of undeveloped Flowerfield acreage to New York State and a contingent termination of its B2K agreement; no definitive agreements have been reached.
The company believes a State sale could close in the second half of 2027, while unresolved site-plan issues create material risk the B2K transaction will not close by the end of 2028.
Staff reductions are expected to save approximately $620,000 over the remaining liquidation period; occupancy was 80% at June 30, 2026.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Gyrodyne Estimates Liquidation Net Assets at $10.75 per Share, Pursues New York State Sale
